outcome: Admission to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit
cohort: Women with a disability who received pregnancy care through a specialized disability clinic (WIN clinic) at the Royal Women's Hospital in Melbourne, Australia, from 2014-2018 (N = 111), compared with all women who gave birth at the hospital in 2017 and 2018 (N = 15,024)
finding: Women with disabilities who received pregnancy care at the WIN clinic were more likely to have a caesarean section, preterm birth, and their infants had a higher likelihood of low birth weight, requiring resuscitation, being admitted to the NICU, and receiving formula in the hospital.
